name: A later request uses what an earlier one learned
purpose: A later request can use what an earlier one learned.
record: Seventeen invented, neutral cases (source tag invented-neutral, evaluation/long_term_memory/build_cases.py): items are retained for people, a request is recalled at a fixed clock, and the ids recalled must equal the expected ones in order. Rules exercised: the subject match, nothing for an unrelated or content-free request, newer first on equal relevance, a clearly better match over a weaker newer one, one person never sees another's items, the retention period, the limit, one item per id, a paraphrase that shares no word. One number: the share of cases that recall exactly the expected ids, balanced with cost and time by [balance.long_term_memory] (weights and budgets fixed before any arm was scored).
disadvantages: Sixteen invented cases that test words, not meaning, so a meaning-based arm would need a paraphrase set and a paid second stage; a consumer's real histories are scored by the consumer's own arm over cases built on this metric.
cascading_conditionals: free [sample=full | real=no | gate=competitive | when=the arm and its rivals were recorded on the same cases]
command: esoi run long_term_memory --impl file_recall; esoi run long_term_memory --impl card_store_recall; esoi run long_term_memory --impl recent_window

name: An objective persists until it is met
purpose: An objective persists and progress is checked against its done-standard.
record: Rule cases written with invented neutral objectives (a garden, a house move, a study plan, a trip), every case tagged origin rule and naming the rule it exercises (evaluation/live_objectives/build_cases.py): a goal rolls up to its parent, an objective is met only when every unit is, and a request goes under the live objective it serves with its path from the top. One number: the share of cases whose whole answer equals the reviewed one, balanced with cost and time by [balance.live_objectives], weights and budgets fixed before any arm was scored.
disadvantages: Twenty invented cases from the stated rules, none from a recording of real use, so they show that the rules hold and not how often real requests are phrased in other words; a model or retrieval arm for placement is specified and not built.
cascading_conditionals: free [sample=full | real=no | gate=competitive | when=the arm and its rivals were recorded on the same cases]
command: esoi run live_objectives --impl rolled_up; esoi run live_objectives --impl flat_list
